ops.title: Release BM25 term keys from document backing storage
ops.description: Owner: /root. Source-pinned BM25 token keys can retain an entire enriched document buffer: regex token views survive toLowerASCII unchanged, and AddDocument stores those views in the long-lived term dictionary. Both 0.83.3 source4731389 and installed19 source528e retain this shape. This is not yet live PID heap attribution. Root private source160fc at /Users/yasyf/repos/ccx-bm25-term-ownership interns one owned strings.Clone per lexeme and appends postings by numeric slot, preserving query score arithmetic/order. Next executable step: independent source refutation, then one CI old-negative/fixed ownership case with exact failure marker plus existing ranking oracles/full required CI. No local product builds/tests or protected MCP actions. Evidence: source-input JSON ce704c6e2ef03a6c0e928297f8cdf3359869096b1ba7af6fd9d4456ccb3d262a. Current 60694 RSS7.497GB is only a different-point process snapshot, not proof this mechanism explains its retained heap; old-client adoption stays separate taskca90.
